lines.trans: Whoa! Why is my seating chart tugging like a sailboat out on the open sea?!
Pinch both bottom corners tight, Zhou—a huge gust just poured through the arch!
Look up! Line one of the paper lanterns is tangling and spinning around line two!

words.gloss: measure word for streets, rivers, towels, clauses
measure word for streets, rivers, towels, clauses

lines.trans: Oh no, my glasses are slipping off my forehead—let me free one hand to catch them!

words.gloss: measure word (for one of a pair/bird/boat)

lines.trans: Zhou, whatever you do, don't let go of that right corner of the paper!
Whoosh—Tables One through Seven, come right back! Stop flying toward the courtyard tree!
I almost caught it by the herb pots—watch out, it just caught a second breeze!
It's gliding past table four, banking left, and heading straight for the courtyard stone basin!
Not into the stone water basin! That's water-soluble blue ink, not waterproof paint!
Dive left, Qing! Grab the dry corner before it slams face down into the water!
Splash... right into the exact center of the basin like a big white paper boat.

Goodbye!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí xià. Placed after an action verb to make a request or suggestion sound casual and brief (看一下, 等一下).

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí yàng. Pairs with 跟/和 in 跟…一样 ('the same as…').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 哎呀！我跑得太急，包装看着都一样！
examples.trans: Oh no! I was running in such a rush that the wrappers all looked alike!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qī. Cardinal number 7; combines with 月 for July and 点 for seven o'clock.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià. Used for downward motion ('go down'), location ('under'), or 'next' (下周).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià lái. Compound directional complement for downward motion or writing something down to keep.

examples.text: 快问他叫什么名字！记下来！
examples.trans: Quick, ask him what his name is! Write it down!

examples.text: 请一定写下来！三楼热水：满分十分！
examples.trans: Please be sure to write that down! Third-floor hot water: ten out of ten!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最下面 ('the bottom part').

examples.text: 快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
examples.trans: Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!

examples.text: 志豪先生早！在木房梁下面睡得好吗？
examples.trans: Morning, Mr Zhihao! Did you sleep well beneath the wooden beams?

meanings.en: right in the exact middle; neither leaning left nor right; impartial
meanings.note: Pinyin: bù piān bù yǐ. Four-character chengyu used both physically for landing squarely on target and figuratively for fair judgment.

examples.text: 哗啦……不偏不倚落进水盆正中央，像只大白纸船。
examples.trans: Splash... right into the exact center of the basin like a big white paper boat.

examples.text: 老陈把木头隔条不偏不倚绑在两条灯笼绳正中间。
examples.trans: Chen tied the wooden spacer bar dead center between the two lantern cords.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bú shì. In 不是……吗？, forms a rhetorical question ('didn't you...? / isn't it...?'); bù shifts to bú before 4th-tone shì.

examples.text: 你不是说今天下午要去集市吗？
examples.trans: Didn't you say you were going to the market this afternoon?

examples.text: 那把钥匙不是一直放在抽屉里吗？
examples.trans: Hasn't that key been in the drawer all along?

examples.text: 这是两个啊。
examples.trans: This is two.

examples.text: 那个两个好。
examples.trans: That two is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng yāng. Compound 中 ('middle') + 央 ('center'); also used in music for the middle register (中央八度 'middle octave').

examples.text: 院子中央摆着一张干净的木头圆桌。
examples.trans: A clean round wooden table stands in the center of the courtyard.

examples.text: 请把手放在钢琴键盘的中央。
examples.trans: Please place your hands at the center of the piano keyboard.

meanings.en: to ride on; to take advantage of a breeze or opportunity
meanings.note: Pinyin: chéng. Used for riding vehicles (乘车) as well as catching a gust of wind (乘风).

examples.text: 在草药花盆那儿差点儿抓住了——小心，它又乘上第二阵风了！
examples.trans: I almost caught it by the herb pots—watch out, it just caught a second breeze!

examples.text: 那位老地图师改乘下午快车，三点整就到成都。
examples.trans: The retired mapmaker switched to riding the afternoon express and arrives in Chengdu at three sharp.

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cóng. Marks a starting point in space or time (从早上到晚上 'from morning to night').

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhù. Means 'reside/stay overnight' as a main verb, or 'firmly in place' as a result complement (记住, 拿住).

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ men. Plural 'you' for addressing two or more people (including polite groups).

examples.text: 太谢谢你们两位了。
examples.trans: Thank you both so very much.

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎ. Colloquial fusion of 两个, never followed by 个 (我们俩 'the two of us').

examples.text: 啊！黄色柠檬糖霜——每个星期五我们俩都抢边角那一块！
examples.trans: Oh! Yellow lemon glaze—every single Friday the two of us fought over the corner piece!

examples.text: 别动，你们俩。听到路边汽车停下的声音了吗？
examples.trans: Hold still, both of you. Hear that car engine stopping at the curb?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò mèng. Separable verb-object compound ('dream').

examples.text: 我在做梦吗？！志豪，这场重逢是你安排的吗？
examples.trans: Am I dreaming?! Zhihao, did you plan this whole reunion?

examples.text: 昨晚我睡得真香，连做梦都没有。
examples.trans: I slept so soundly last night that I did not even dream.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàng. Introduces a likeness or example ('look like, be like').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 他长得真像他哥哥。
examples.trans: He really looks like his older brother.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài jiàn. Standard Mandarin farewell at any time of day.

examples.text: 路上小心，我们明天再见！
examples.trans: Take care on the road—see you again tomorrow!

examples.text: 谢谢您的帮忙，再见！
examples.trans: Thank you for your help—goodbye!

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng. Placed right before a verb to show the action happened moments ago.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

examples.text: 一到七号钥匙全拿走了，八号房刚刷了油漆。
examples.trans: Every key from one to seven is taken, and room eight just got fresh paint.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bié. Most commonly means 'do not' in polite commands (别担心 'don't worry'); as a verb, 'pin/clip on'.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。
examples.trans: Please sit down first and do not worry; we will check the luggage tag right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Works as main verb ('arrive') or result complement ('succeed in reaching/perceiving', 找到, 听到).

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.en: by all means; be sure (not) to
meanings.note: Pinyin: qiān wàn. Strong, caring emphasis before 别 or 要 (千万别忘 'whatever you do, don't forget').

examples.text: 我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
examples.trans: I have not had my morning coffee yet; please do not say emergency!

examples.text: 小美，千万别因为我们多忙活。
examples.trans: Mei, please do not go to extra trouble on our account.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qù. Movement away from the speaker, as main verb (去车站) or directional complement (上去).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu. Marks an action repeating, or pairs two qualities in 又A又B ('both A and B').

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
examples.trans: Another dark-blue suitcase! Is this Teacher Song's?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Read zhǐ as the adverb 'only' before verbs, and zhī as a measure word for cups, boxes, and small animals.

examples.text: 而且他今晚八点到这里——只剩四十分钟了！
examples.trans: And he arrives here at eight o'clock this evening—in forty minutes!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kě shì. Conversational 'but' introducing a contrast.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 外面一模一样，可是你看里面！
examples.trans: The outside is identical, yet look inside!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu bian. Measure word (量词): 边 (biān), e.g. 右边 ('the right side').

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 挂在书桌右边吧，那里光线好。
examples.trans: Hang it to the right of the desk, where the light is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个名字 ('a name').

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 上面有名字或者电话号码吗？
examples.trans: Is there a name or a phone number on it?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ya. Gentle exclamation of surprise or realization.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
examples.trans: Oh, is this that twin suitcase from Monday's train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: gào su. Takes a person directly followed by the information (告诉我 'tell me').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: ne. After a noun, asks 'what about X?' (你呢？); at the end of a statement, highlights an ongoing situation.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hū. Imitates letting out a relieved breath.

examples.text: 呼，好在反应快，早餐又有救了！
examples.trans: Phew, quick thinking saves breakfast once again!

examples.text: 呼，终于赶上早班火车了。
examples.trans: Phew, we finally caught the morning train.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Joins nouns or pronouns ('A and B'), NEVER two whole clauses; also means 'with' (和你一样).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wā. Expresses admiration or delight.

examples.text: 哇，看这间房！大木头房梁，窗户正对着院子！
examples.trans: Wow, look at this room! Big wooden beams, and a window facing the courtyard!

examples.text: 插上老陈的铜台灯……哇，黄色灯光真暖和！
examples.trans: Plug in Chen's brass lamp... wow, how warm that yellow light is!

meanings.en: sound of splashing water, clattering objects, or rustling sheets
meanings.note: Pinyin: huā lā. Onomatopoeia built with mouth radicals (口) to mimic sudden water splashes or falling items.

examples.text: 哗啦……不偏不倚落进水盆正中央，像只大白纸船。
examples.trans: Splash... right into the exact center of the basin like a big white paper boat.

examples.text: 老陈解开帆布袋，三十个桦木衣夹哗啦一声倒在桌面上。
examples.trans: Chen untied the canvas bag, and thirty birch clothespins tumbled onto the desk with a clatter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǎr. Spoken northern/standard variant of 哪里 ('where').

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí lái. Directional compound for returning toward the speaker's place.

examples.text: 一点没破！是谁送回来的？
examples.trans: Not cracked at all! Who brought it back?

examples.text: 付了现金！打开工具箱等我，我往桥那边跑回来了！
examples.trans: Paid in cash! Open your toolbox and wait—I am running back across the bridge!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tú. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张图 ('a plan').

examples.text: 里面有……一把大门钥匙、一张蓝色的图，还有明信片。
examples.trans: Inside there's... one big door key, a blue plan, and postcards.

examples.text: 老陈在纸上画了一张去五金店的图。
examples.trans: Chen drew a map to the hardware shop on a piece of paper.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mò shuǐ. Liquid writing ink for fountain pens. Measure word: 瓶 (píng, 'bottle').

examples.text: 这页旧信是用深蓝色墨水写的。
examples.trans: This old letter page was written in dark blue ink.

examples.text: 桌上的钢笔没墨水了，我得去加一点。
examples.trans: The fountain pen on the desk is out of ink; I need to refill it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà. Everyday adjective for size, age, and strong wind or rain.

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà hǎi. Everyday disyllabic word for the wide sea, used literally or in vivid comparisons.

examples.text: 哇！我的座位图怎么像大海上的帆船一样直往外拽？！
examples.trans: Whoa! Why is my seating chart tugging like a sailboat out on the open sea?!

examples.text: 老陈说，当年他叔叔的大海行船经验正好帮上了二楼灯笼的忙。
examples.trans: Chen said his uncle's sea-boat experience came in handy right away for the upper balcony lanterns.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tā. Third-person singular pronoun for objects, animals, and places.

examples.text: 是啊，宋老师，还在等它的主人呢。
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, still waiting for its owner.

examples.text: 别念叨它，宋老师！我现在差不多喜欢上那两声响了。
examples.trans: Don't tempt it, Teacher Song! I have almost grown fond of those two rings now.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo xīn. Literally 'small heart'—pay close attention.

examples.text: 小心，周经理，壶嘴很宽！
examples.trans: Careful, Manager Zhou, the pitcher spout is wide!

examples.text: 拐弯小心点，别碰到墙！
examples.trans: Careful on the turn—do not bump the wall!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo qíng. Friendly name of Courtyard Inn's new receptionist.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuǒ. Measure word (量词): 边 (biān), e.g. 左边 ('the left side').

examples.text: 上楼梯，平台往左拐，最上面最后一扇门。
examples.trans: Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the very top.

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chà diǎnr. Erhua colloquial adverb 差 ('fall short by') + 点儿 ('a tiny bit'): indicates something came within a hair's breadth of happening.

examples.text: 听到敲门声的时候，周经理的心差点儿跳过了院子里的树！
examples.trans: When he heard the knock at the gate, Manager Zhou's heart nearly jumped over the courtyard tree!

examples.text: 小晴差点儿把白盐当成白糖放进柠檬酱里。
examples.trans: Qing almost put white salt into the lemon curd thinking it was sugar.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fān chuán. Measure word (量词): 艘 (sōu) or 条 (tiáo). Joins 帆 (sail) with 船 (boat).

examples.text: 哇！我的座位图怎么像大海上的帆船一样直往外拽？！
examples.trans: Whoa! Why is my seating chart tugging like a sailboat out on the open sea?!

examples.text: 老陈用木头隔条绑紧灯笼绳，说原理跟帆船上的横木一样。
examples.trans: Chen tied wooden spacer bars across the lantern cords, saying the idea works just like spars on a sailboat.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gàn. Read gàn when meaning 'do work / get a job done' (干得不错 'nicely done!').

examples.text: 第二天上班，干得不错，新手。
examples.trans: For day two on the job, nicely done, rookie.

examples.text: 不许盯着客人看。把箱子交还，干自己的活。
examples.trans: No staring at guests. Hand back the bag and do our own work.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò wèi. Combines 座 ('seat/place') + 位 ('spot/position'); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 九号房里的十二个室内座位既明亮又宽敞。
examples.trans: The twelve indoor seats inside Room Nine are both bright and spacious.

examples.text: 请给面包师和音乐老师在钢琴旁边留两个好座位。
examples.trans: Please save two good seats beside the piano for the baker and the music teacher.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi. Versatile verb for opening doors, starting business, turning on taps/lights, or water boiling.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎng. Guides movement in directions (往上提 'lift upward', 往左拐 'turn left').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎng wài. Directional phrase 往 ('toward') + 外 ('outside').

examples.text: 透过擦干净的拱窗往外看，整个院子绿油油的。
examples.trans: Looking outward through the clean arched window, the whole courtyard is lush green.

examples.text: 这两扇木头窗板是往外推开的。
examples.trans: These two wooden shutters swing open outward.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. As an adjective/adverb, 'fast/quickly'; in 快…了, 'about to'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zěn me. Before a verb, asks 'how to do X?' (怎么走) or 'how come…?' (怎么还没来).

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

examples.text: 宋老师，怎么了？您按了门铃！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, what happened? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a part used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个我的。
examples.trans: I have a 我的.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的我的。
examples.trans: This is a very good 我的.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu. Measure word (量词): 双 (shuāng), e.g. 一双手 ('a pair of hands').

examples.text: 谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
examples.trans: Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!

examples.text: 我手在发抖——车上下来穿深灰色外套的高个子男人吗？
examples.trans: My hands are shaking—is a tall man in a dark grey coat stepping out?

related.gloss: a pair of hands (measure word 双)

meanings.en: to throw oneself forward; dive or pounce toward something
meanings.note: Pinyin: pū. Vivid action verb for diving to catch falling paper or rushing forward.

examples.text: 小晴，往左扑过去！趁它还没脸朝下砸进水里，快拽住干的那一角！
examples.trans: Dive left, Qing! Grab the dry corner before it slams face down into the water!

examples.text: 风把菜单吹飞时，志豪一个箭步扑过去按住了纸角。
examples.trans: When wind lifted the menu, Hao lunged forward in one stride and pinned down the corner.

meanings.en: hit; make (a call); give (a score); fetch
meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ. Light verb forming dozens of everyday expressions (打电话 'make a phone call').

examples.text: 小晴，马上给火车站失物处打电话。
examples.trans: Qing, call the train station lost-and-found office right away.

examples.text: 我正在打……您好，请问有人找蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: I am calling now... Hello, excuse me, is anyone looking for a blue suitcase?

扶.gloss: to steady; prop up; support by hand

meanings.en: to steady with one's hand; support someone or straighten something tilted
meanings.note: Pinyin: fú. Used for steadying glasses (扶一下眼镜), straightening a crooked easel, or helping an elder walk.

examples.text: 糟了，眼镜从额头上滑下来了——我腾出一只手扶一下！
examples.trans: Oh no, my glasses are slipping off my forehead—let me free one hand to catch them!

examples.text: 风太大了，志鹏快过来帮忙扶住门口那块木画架。
examples.trans: The wind is too strong—Peng, come help steady the wooden easel by the doorway.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuā zhù. Resultative compound 抓 ('grab') + 住 ('hold fast').

examples.text: 小晴稳稳抓住了第一扇木窗板的左头。
examples.trans: Qing grabbed firm hold of the left end of the first wooden shutter.

examples.text: 下梯子的时候请双手抓住两边的扶手。
examples.trans: When coming down the ladder, please hold tightly onto both side rails.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tái tóu. Separable verb-object compound; opposite of 低头.

examples.text: 高个子，深灰色外套，正抬头看我们客栈招牌呢！
examples.trans: Tall, dark grey coat, looking up at our inn sign right now!

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: guǎi. Everyday direction verb (往左拐 'turn left').

examples.text: 上楼梯，平台往左拐，最上面最后一扇门。
examples.trans: Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the very top.

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gǒng mén. Compound 拱 ('arch') + 门 ('door/gate'). Measure word: 道 (dào) or 扇 (shàn).

examples.text: 志豪在速写本上画下了院子的石头拱门。
examples.trans: Hao sketched the courtyard's stone archway in his sketchbook.

examples.text: 穿过这道砖拱门，就能看见后面的小花园。
examples.trans: Walk through this brick archway and you can see the little garden behind.

meanings.en: to pull hard; tug forcefully or catch hold of
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuāi. Expresses stronger, more sudden pulling force than plain 拉 (lā, pull).

examples.text: 哇！我的座位图怎么像大海上的帆船一样直往外拽？！
examples.trans: Whoa! Why is my seating chart tugging like a sailboat out on the open sea?!

examples.text: 小晴，往左扑过去！趁它还没脸朝下砸进水里，快拽住干的那一角！
examples.trans: Dive left, Qing! Grab the dry corner before it slams face down into the water!

meanings.note: Pinyin: niē. Action verb for picking up a tiny pinch of salt/sugar with the fingers or shaping dough by hand.

examples.text: 明天早上六点烤点心以前，我们先捏一点点白粉末尝尝就行。
examples.trans: Tomorrow morning at six before baking, we can just pinch a tiny bit of the white powder to taste.

examples.text: 小美教志鹏怎么用手指把杏仁挞皮的边缘捏出漂亮的花纹。
examples.trans: Mei showed Peng how to pinch a neat fluted pattern around the edge of the almond tart shells.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diào. As a verb, 'drop'; after another verb, marks removal or disposal (关掉 'turn off', 擦掉 'wipe away').

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。
examples.trans: Used the last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge carries this size.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cháo. Describes which way a window faces or waving toward someone (朝院子 'facing the courtyard').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

条.gloss: measure word for streets, rivers, towels, clauses

meanings.en: measure word for streets, rivers, towels, clauses
meanings.note: Pinyin: tiáo. Counts long, narrow, or winding things: streets, rivers, scarves, towels, trousers, and legal clauses (一条街).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sōng. Describes a loose screw/handle or relaxing tension (松一口气 'breathe a sigh of relief').

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

examples.text: 太松一口气了！志豪先生，给您银钥匙。
examples.trans: What a relief! Mr Zhihao, here is your silver key.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shù. Measure word (量词): 棵, e.g. 一棵树 ('a tree').

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

examples.text: 只有院子里的老树和雨声。
examples.trans: Only the old tree in the courtyard and the sound of rain.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuō. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张桌子 ('a table').

examples.text: 等等——小美这会儿正要把蛋糕端到他们那桌去。
examples.trans: Wait—Mei is taking the cake out to their table right now.

examples.text: 从明天早上八点开始！屋里四张桌，树下三张桌！
examples.trans: Starting tomorrow morning at eight! Four tables indoors, three tables under the tree!

meanings.en: right in the middle of; squarely; right
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng. Before a verb, marks an action in progress right now; before 对着, means 'directly/squarely'.

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuǐ. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯水 ('a glass of water').

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

examples.text: 摸摸热水管——下面是温的，上面变凉了。
examples.trans: Feel the hot-water pipe—the bottom is warm, while the top is turning cool.

related.gloss: a glass of water (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuǐ róng. Commonly paired with 墨水 (ink) or 颜料 (pigment).

examples.text: 千万别掉进石水盆！那可是水溶蓝墨水，不是防水漆呀！
examples.trans: Not into the stone water basin! That's water-soluble blue ink, not waterproof paint!

examples.text: 这盒水溶彩铅沾点清水就能晕开，画院子风景特别方便。
examples.trans: These water-soluble colored pencils blend with a touch of water, making courtyard sketches easy.

meanings.en: water basin; shallow tub or stone bowl holding water
meanings.note: Pinyin: shuǐ pén. Measure word: 个 (gè) or 只 (zhī), e.g. 一个石水盆 ('a stone water basin').

examples.text: 它飘过第四桌，往左一拐，直奔院子里的石水盆去了！
examples.trans: It's gliding past table four, banking left, and heading straight for the courtyard stone basin!

examples.text: 老陈每天清晨都会给院子东头的水盆换上清亮凉水。
examples.trans: Every morning Chen refills the water basin on the east side of the courtyard with fresh cool water.

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi. Short form of 没有; negates 有 and past/completed actions (没锁 'isn't locked / didn't lock').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huá. Describes wet stone steps being slippery or an object sliding down.

examples.text: 周经理！这回您眼镜从鼻子上滑下来是因为太高兴啦！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou! This time your glasses slid off your nose from sheer joy!

examples.text: 听我把箱子斜过来——里面有金属东西滑了一下。
examples.trans: Listen as I tilt the box—something metal slid inside.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qī. Measure word (量词): 桶 (tǒng), e.g. 一桶漆 ('a can of paint').

examples.text: 快看木头后面！白漆，还有一个铜钥匙孔！
examples.trans: Look behind the wood! White paint, and a brass keyhole!

examples.text: 门上的白漆有点旧了。
examples.trans: The white paint on the door is getting a bit old.

related.gloss: a can of paint (measure word 桶)

meanings.note: Verb guàn ('force drinks on someone; pour').

examples.text: 当时我在酒桌上被他们灌多了。
examples.trans: At the table they poured far too many drinks into me.

examples.text: 录制前先给暖手宝灌满热水。
examples.trans: Fill the hand warmer with hot water before taping.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bái. Describes white paper, sugar, or tablecloths.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 看，把手上贴着一个白信封。
examples.trans: Look, there is a white envelope taped onto the handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhí. Describes straight lines or walking straight ahead (直走).

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

meanings.en: to head straight toward; make a beeline for
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhí bēn. Note the falling tone on bēn ('dash straight toward'), distinct from bèn ('rush blindly').

examples.text: 它飘过第四桌，往左一拐，直奔院子里的石水盆去了！
examples.trans: It's gliding past table four, banking left, and heading straight for the courtyard stone basin!

examples.text: 兄弟俩一出客栈大门就直奔车站，一步都没敢耽搁。
examples.trans: The moment the two brothers stepped out of the inn gate, they headed straight for the station without pausing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎn jìng. Measure word (量词): 副 (fù), e.g. 一副眼镜 ('a pair of glasses').

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

related.gloss: a pair of glasses (measure word 副)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.en: stone; rock (often modifying another noun, as in 石水盆 'stone water basin')
meanings.note: Pinyin: shí. As a standalone object, Mandarin usually says 石头 (shítou).

examples.text: 它飘过第四桌，往左一拐，直奔院子里的石水盆去了！
examples.trans: It's gliding past table four, banking left, and heading straight for the courtyard stone basin!

examples.text: 老院子门口那对石狮子陪着梧桐巷过了好几十个夏天。
examples.trans: That pair of stone lions by the old courtyard gate has watched over Wutong Lane for dozens of summers.

meanings.en: to slam down heavily; smash or drop with a thud
meanings.note: Pinyin: zá. Also used figuratively in 办砸了 ('botched something').

examples.text: 小晴，往左扑过去！趁它还没脸朝下砸进水里，快拽住干的那一角！
examples.trans: Dive left, Qing! Grab the dry corner before it slams face down into the water!

examples.text: 风大时要拿石头压住纸角，免得花盆晃倒砸坏了茶杯。
examples.trans: When the wind picks up, weight the paper corners down so a toppling flowerpot does not smash the teacups.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì. Placed before any number to turn it into an ordinal (第一 'first', 第二天 'the second day').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: ordinal number

examples.text: 我是传媒学院的研究生，年级第一名。
examples.trans: I am a graduate student at the Media College, first in my year.

examples.text: 我是传媒学院的研究生，年级第一名。
examples.trans: I am a graduate student at the Media College, first in my year.

examples.text: 这是第二啊。
examples.trans: This is second.

examples.text: 那个第二好。
examples.trans: That second is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì sì. Ordinal number formed with prefix 第 (dì) + 四 ('four').

examples.text: 小美，第四盘柠檬挞还剩几块？
examples.trans: How many slices of lemon tart are left on the fourth tray, Mei?

examples.text: 顺着梧桐巷往前走，第四家店就是老先生的提琴工坊。
examples.trans: Walk down Wutong Lane and the fourth shop is the older gentleman's violin workshop.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zāo le. Spoken exclamation when realizing a mistake.

examples.text: 糟了！周经理，小晴，厨房出急事了！
examples.trans: Oh no! Manager Zhou, Qing, we have a kitchen emergency!

examples.text: 糟了，我把雨伞忘在出租车上了！
examples.trans: Oh no, I left my umbrella in the taxi!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jǐn. Describes tightening a valve (拧紧) or a tight schedule.

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

examples.text: 小晴，把床单角塞紧！放上两个软枕头。
examples.trans: Qing, tuck the sheet corner tight! On go the two soft pillows.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张纸 ('a sheet of paper').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

related.gloss: a sheet of paper (measure word 张)

examples.text: 傍晚时分，廊檐下挂起了一排温暖的红纸灯笼。
examples.trans: At dusk, a row of warm red paper lanterns was hung beneath the eaves.

examples.text: 小美亲手在纸灯笼上画了几枝淡雅的梅花。
examples.trans: Mei painted a few delicate plum branches on the paper lantern by hand.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ chuán. Measure word: 只 (zhī) or 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一只白纸船 ('a white paper boat').

examples.text: 哗啦……不偏不倚落进水盆正中央，像只大白纸船。
examples.trans: Splash... right into the exact center of the basin like a big white paper boat.

examples.text: 小时候下雨天，兄弟俩常折纸船放到小巷积水里比赛漂流。
examples.trans: On rainy days as kids, the two brothers used to fold paper boats and race them in alley puddles.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shéng. General noun for twisted cord or twine (细绳 'fine string/twine', 棉绳 'cotton string'); measure word: 根 (gēn) or 条 (tiáo).

examples.text: 用一根干净的厨房细绳把百里香和欧芹绑在一起，煮完汤方便捞出来。
examples.trans: Tie the thyme and parsley together with a clean piece of kitchen twine so they are easy to lift out after simmering.

examples.text: 木牌上面系着一根结实的麻绳，正好可以挂在大门口的铁钩上。
examples.trans: A sturdy hemp cord is tied to the top of the wooden sign so it hangs right on the iron hook outside the gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chán. Action of winding or binding something around an object.

examples.text: 细细的金线缠在卡片的边缘。
examples.trans: A fine gold thread is wrapped around the edge of the card.

examples.text: 那只小猫被毛线球缠住了爪子，正急得喵喵叫。
examples.trans: The little cat had its paws tangled in the ball of yarn and was meowing anxiously.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎn. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张脸 ('a face').

examples.text: 宋老师，您一脸惊讶！您认识梧桐巷十二号吗？
examples.trans: Teacher Song, you look amazed! Do you know Number twelve, Wutong Lane?

examples.text: 他用温水洗了一把脸。
examples.trans: He washed his face with warm water.

meanings.en: to free up a hand, time, or space
meanings.note: Pinyin: téng chū. Frequently pairs with 手 ('a hand'), 时间 ('time'), or 地方 ('room').

examples.text: 糟了，眼镜从额头上滑下来了——我腾出一只手扶一下！
examples.trans: Oh no, my glasses are slipping off my forehead—let me free one hand to catch them!

examples.text: 大伙儿刚忙完烘焙，总算腾出五分钟坐下来听钢琴了。
examples.trans: Having just finished baking, everyone finally freed up five minutes to sit and listen to the piano.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huā pén. Compound 花 ('flower') + 盆 ('pot/basin'). Measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 院子台阶两旁摆着六个红陶花盆。
examples.trans: Six terracotta flowerpots sit along both sides of the courtyard steps.

examples.text: 小美买了薄荷和迷迭香，准备种在花盆里。
examples.trans: Mei bought mint and rosemary to plant in the flowerpots.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cǎo yào. Measure word: 株 (zhū) or 棵 (kē) for a plant, 包 (bāo) for dried herbs.

examples.text: 在草药花盆那儿差点儿抓住了——小心，它又乘上第二阵风了！
examples.trans: I almost caught it by the herb pots—watch out, it just caught a second breeze!

examples.text: 九号房阳台上种着几盆小草药，平时泡茶煮菜都能随手摘几片。
examples.trans: A few pots of herbs grow on Room Nine's balcony, handy for picking leaves for tea or cooking.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yào shī. Measure word: 位 (wèi) politely, e.g. 街角那位药师 ('the pharmacist on the corner').

examples.text: 你们俩快告诉我这是做梦——药师和面包师的名字跑哪儿去了？！
examples.trans: Tell me I'm dreaming, you two—where did the pharmacist and the baker run off to?!

examples.text: 梧桐巷口的张药师答应星期六下午带着小提琴来院子里凑热闹。
examples.trans: Apothecary Zhang from the corner of Wutong Lane promised to bring his violin to the courtyard on Saturday afternoon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: luò. Used both literally for raindrops/leaves falling and musically for a phrase landing on a note (落在中央瑞音上).

examples.text: 到了第二十八小节，整段旋律稳稳落在了中央瑞音上。
examples.trans: In bar twenty-eight, the whole melody lands squarely on middle D.

examples.text: 几片金黄的梧桐叶轻轻落在院子的石桌上。
examples.trans: Several golden plane-tree leaves drifted gently down onto the courtyard stone table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lán. Describes blue suitcases, doors, or teacups.

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

examples.text: 储藏室里有两个软枕头和一块蓝地毯！
examples.trans: In the storeroom there are two soft pillows and a blue rug!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎo. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个角落 ('a corner').

examples.text: 小晴，把床单角塞紧！放上两个软枕头。
examples.trans: Qing, tuck the sheet corner tight! On go the two soft pillows.

examples.text: 信封右上角贴着一张邮票。
examples.trans: A stamp is stuck on the upper-right corner of the envelope.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chèn. Introduces a favorable moment before it passes (趁热吃 'eat while it's hot').

examples.text: 趁着阳光亮，我能再看看那张小纸牌吗？
examples.trans: While the sunlight is bright, may I look at that small paper tag again?

examples.text: 太好了……趁着等他们，我扫一眼这封房东来信。
examples.trans: Wonderful... while we wait, let me glance at this letter from the landlord.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pǎo. Everyday verb for running.

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

examples.text: 十分钟之内你能跑个来回吗？
examples.trans: Can you run there and back within ten minutes?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuàn. Read zhuàn for spinning wheels or quick wits (脑子转得快 'mind works fast').

examples.text: 脑子转得快，小晴。志豪每星期都读城市建筑规定。
examples.trans: Quick thinking, Qing. Hao reads city building rules every single week.

examples.text: 风一吹，纸风车就飞快地转起来。
examples.trans: When the breeze blows, the paper pinwheel spins fast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guò. Read neutral-tone guo after a verb for 'have ever done' (见过); read guò as a verb meaning 'cross/pass' (过河 'cross the river').

examples.text: 早跟你说过，那个平板是个坑。
examples.trans: Told you before, that tablet is a trap.

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

meanings.note: Pinyin: guò qù. Directional compound moving across toward another spot.

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

examples.text: 二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
examples.trans: Twenty millimetres, brass, water-heater valve—I will repeat it all the way!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái. Everyday adverb meaning 'still' (还在), 'not yet' (还没), or 'even more' after 比.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

examples.text: 这是什么套啊？
examples.trans: What kind of setup?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn. Movement into an enclosed space (请进 'come in!', 倒进 'pour into').

examples.text: 小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
examples.trans: Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn lái. Friendly invitation 请进来 ('please come in').

examples.text: 等星期五中午箱子主人进来，我一定坐第一排看！
examples.trans: When the suitcase owner walks in Friday at noon, I am sitting in the front row!

examples.text: 晚上好！先生，快进来避避雨吧。
examples.trans: Good evening! Sir, come inside quickly out of the rain.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

examples.text: 最想搞掉的就是那个淳于乔。
examples.trans: The one you want to take down most is that Chun Yuqiao.

examples.text: 靠墙的那个深蓝色皮箱是昨天傍晚刚寄到的。
examples.trans: That dark blue leather suitcase against the wall just arrived yesterday evening.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nàr. Spoken variant of 那里 ('there').

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

examples.text: 看车轮底下——铅笔写的你和我的名字还在那儿。
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels—your name and mine in pencil are still right there.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng shuǐ. Literal structure: 'guard against water'; contrasts with 水溶 ('water-soluble').

examples.text: 千万别掉进石水盆！那可是水溶蓝墨水，不是防水漆呀！
examples.trans: Not into the stone water basin! That's water-soluble blue ink, not waterproof paint!

examples.text: 小美把蛋糕方子放进防水塑料封套里，再也不怕沾上茶水了。
examples.trans: Mei sealed the cake recipe inside a waterproof plastic sleeve so tea splashes can never ruin it.

meanings.en: measure word for a passing spell, gust of wind, burst of applause, or shower
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèn. Used in 一阵风 ('a gust of wind') and 一阵掌声 ('a burst of applause').

examples.text: 刚才从街口拱门吹过来的那阵凉风，你们感觉到了吗？
examples.trans: Did you feel that cool gust blowing through the street arch just now?

examples.text: 琴声刚落，树荫底下就响起了一阵热烈又长久的掌声。
examples.trans: As soon as the piano stopped, a warm, lingering burst of applause rose from under the shade tree.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: miàn bāo shī. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位面包师 ('a baker').

examples.text: 看下一张：请给面包师和老师留两把角落的椅子。
examples.trans: Look at the next one: 'Please save two corner chairs for the baker and the teacher.'

examples.text: 这家店的面包师每天四点起床。
examples.trans: The baker at this shop gets up at four every day.

meanings.note: Pinyin: é tóu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个额头 ('a forehead').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 笔挺又干净，周经理！连眼镜都戴在鼻子上，没在额头上。
examples.trans: Crisp and spotless, Manager Zhou! Even your glasses are on your nose instead of your forehead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng. Measure word (量词): 阵, e.g. 一阵风 ('a gust of wind').

examples.text: 热汤？在冷雨中走过来之后，这听起来太棒了。
examples.trans: Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.

examples.text: 春天下午的风又轻又暖。
examples.trans: The spring afternoon breeze is gentle and warm.

related.gloss: a gust of wind (measure word 阵)

meanings.note: Pinyin: piāo. Describes music, fragrance, leaves, or clouds floating gently through the air (飘出去 'drift out', 飘到树底下 'float out under the tree').

examples.text: 把对着院子的两扇拱窗敞开吧，让钢琴声飘到外面的梧桐巷去。
examples.trans: Open wide the two arched windows facing the courtyard so the piano music can drift out to Wutong Lane.

examples.text: 开头的四个音符从阳光房飘出来，一直飘到院子的大树底下。
examples.trans: The opening four notes floated out from the sunroom all the way under the big courtyard tree.

examples.text: 上个月你三天绕地球飞了一整圈，回来开电话会议，中文英文一个字没错过。
examples.trans: Last month you flew around the globe in three days and took a bilingual conference call without missing a single word!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.
